title: Return window and refund timelines
body:
You can return most items within 30 days of delivery.

Refunds reach the original payment method within 7 business days after the return is received at the warehouse.

title: Tracking your Acme order
body:
Every order has an order number that starts with AC-. Sign in and ask the assistant for the order status with that number.

Orders ship within 2 working days.

title: Card declined at checkout
body:
A declined card is usually a bank limit or a mistyped CVV. Try again or use UPI.

We never ask for your full card number or OTP.
